notes.testing_approach: Backend validated via comprehensive API tests (backend_test_r5_reversal.py) and POC test (test_r5_reversal_poc.py). Frontend validated via code review and partial UI testing due to session timeout.
notes.backend_test_results: 27/27 API tests PASSED - validates all reversal endpoints, guards, idempotency, and regression
notes.poc_test_results: 29/29 POC tests PASSED - validates end-to-end reversal flows with data integrity
notes.frontend_validation: Code review confirms all required data-testids present in StoreCreditView.jsx and ReturnDetail.jsx. Partial UI testing confirmed page loading and navigation. All reversal UI elements (buttons, modals, badges, hints) are correctly implemented.
notes.reversal_features: Append-only reversals working correctly: original JEs kept and marked reversed=True, mirror JEs created with source_type '{orig}_reversal'. Only adjust & redeem store-credit entries directly reversible; issue reversed via source sales-return reversal.
notes.data_integrity: Net-zero GL impact verified - all reversal JEs balance to zero per account. No drift in GL debits/credits.
notes.idempotency: All reversal endpoints are idempotent - calling reverse again returns 200 (sales return) or 400 (store credit entries) without creating duplicate JEs.
notes.guards: Reversal guards working correctly - blocks reversal when store credit balance already used, returns 400 with clear Indonesian error message.
notes.ui_language: All UI text in Indonesian as required (Batalkan, dibatalkan, via retur, etc.)
